versions.changelog:
Initial release – instantly route prompts to the top LLM based on peer-reviewed council rankings.

- Route any prompt to the best-performing LLM via a single API call.
- Models are chosen using thousands of peer-reviewed council deliberations.
- Response includes model recommendation, relevance & confidence scores, and detailed model rankings.
- Fully compatible with OpenRouter model catalogue – use results directly without mapping.
- Requires a free API key from llmcouncil.ai; free and pro usage tiers available.
